mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0%, it signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in housing starts signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has increased and HOUST has decreased in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPI) over the past 3 months signals rising inflation, which compresses real equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL has increased for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and negative payroll employment growth (PAYEMS change < 0) signals a severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100 and PAYEMS growth is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-interest-rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), a decline in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and RSAFS declines.
